summary: Synaptics, a Delaware semiconductor company, filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing an Amended and Restated Agreement and Plan of Merger under which ON Semiconductor (onsemi) will acquire Synaptics via merger of Sonic Acquisition Corp. into Synaptics, which survives as an indirect wholly-owned onsemi subsidiary. The amendment followed a September 2, 2026 unsolicited proposal from Party A deemed a Superior Proposal, then rejected after onsemi negotiations. Synaptics' board unanimously approved the agreement as advisable and fair. Watch for proxy timing, competing bids, and regulatory clearance risk.
